name: Double solid yellow center line
meaning: Separates traffic moving in opposite directions; passing is not allowed from either side.

name: Solid and broken yellow center lines
meaning: Drivers on the side with the broken line may pass when it is safe; drivers on the side with the solid line may not pass.

name: Broken yellow center line
meaning: Two-way traffic; you may pass on the left when the way ahead is clear and it is safe.

name: Broken white lane lines
meaning: Separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction; you may change lanes when it is safe.

name: Solid white lane line
meaning: Separates lanes moving in the same direction where lane changes are discouraged or prohibited; stay in your lane.

name: Edge lines
meaning: A solid yellow line marks the left edge of a divided or one-way road; a solid white line marks the right edge.

name: Two-way left-turn lane
meaning: The center lane is shared by drivers in both directions for making left turns only; do not use it for passing or travel.

name: Stop line and crosswalk
meaning: When required to stop, stop before the stop line; if there is none, stop before the crosswalk.

name: Yield line (shark teeth)
meaning: The triangles point toward approaching drivers and show where to yield or stop when required.

name: HOV / restricted lane diamond
meaning: The diamond marks a lane reserved for certain vehicles, such as carpools or buses, as posted on signs.

name: Bike lane
meaning: A lane reserved for bicycles, marked with a solid white line and a bicycle symbol; drivers may cross it only to turn or park where permitted, after yielding to cyclists.

name: Railroad crossing pavement marking
meaning: An X with the letters RR painted before a railroad crossing warns you to slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

name: Reversible lane
meaning: A lane bounded by double broken yellow lines whose direction changes at certain times; check signs or lane-use signals before using it.

name: Lane-use arrows
meaning: Arrows on the pavement show which movements are allowed from each lane: left turn only, straight, or right turn only.

name: Gore area (painted island)
meaning: The striped area between a freeway and a ramp; do not drive or stop on it.

name: Hand signal: left turn
meaning: Left arm and hand extended straight out the window means the driver will turn left.

name: Hand signal: right turn
meaning: Left arm extended out with the forearm and hand pointing up means the driver will turn right.

name: Hand signal: slow or stop
meaning: Left arm extended out with the forearm and hand pointing down means the driver will slow down or stop.
